source_caption_text:
42 Dugg slid on this 😤🔥

Tyler, The Creator’s “LEMONHEAD” featuring 42 Dugg is a perfect example of two artists with completely different styles coming together on one track. When Dugg’s verse starts, he wastes no time showing why his flow stands out, sliding over the beat with his distinct voice and effortless delivery.

42 Dugg doesn’t need to do too much to make his verse hit. His flow sounds effortless, and the way he switches up his delivery over those loud horns and hard drums makes you want to run his part back as soon as it ends. He fits right into the beat without losing that signature Detroit sound.

Tyler and 42 Dugg have completely different styles, but that’s what makes this collab work so well. Dugg brings his own energy to the track and holds his own next to Tyler, making his verse one of the standout moments on “CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST.” 

#tylerthecreator #42dugg #lemonhead
